ValidationRule.description: Cannot schedule an appointment with a doctor who is on leave (Status = Inactive / On Leave).
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(ISBLANK(Doctor__c)), OR(ISNEW(), ISCHANGED(Doctor__c), ISCHANGED(Appointment_Date__c)), OR( ISPICKVAL(Doctor__r.Status__c, "Inactive"), ISPICKVAL(Doctor__r.Status__c, "On Leave") ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: This doctor is inactive or on leave and cannot be booked.
